headline: Last session: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Banking and IT stocks supported a strong market recovery during the last trading session.
Foreign inflows lifted the domestic market despite early weak global cues.
Nifty Bank reached a record high level during Friday's trade.
Markets rebounded strongly after opening lower due to global AI selloff concerns.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, Saturday, 21 November 2026, for the weekend.
On the last trading day (Nov 20), Sensex jumped 898 points to close higher.
Nifty50 ended at 25,801 after recovering from morning losses.
Apollo Hospitals emerged as one of the leading gainers in the Nifty50 index.
summary:
In the last trading session, Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed the 25,800 level, lifted by banking stocks and foreign inflows.
Markets successfully rebounded from an early slump caused by a global AI selloff, with Nifty Bank touching a record high and Apollo Hospitals leading the rally.
The equity market is closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 23 November.
